description: This file defines the PurgeService class in the OrangeHRM project, providing functionality for GDPR data purging related to employees and candidates. It manages database transactions, invokes purge strategies, and dispatches events upon completion.

classes.name: PurgeService
classes.description: Service class responsible for purging employee and candidate data based on GDPR compliance, utilizing various strategies and event dispatching.

methods.name: getPurgeDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of PurgeDao, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getEmployeePictureService
methods.description: Returns an instance of EmployeePictureService, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: purgeEmployeeData
methods.description: Initiates a transaction to purge all data related to an employee identified by employee number.

methods.name: purgeCandidateData
methods.description: Initiates a transaction to purge data related to a candidate identified by vacancy ID.

methods.name: getPurgeableEntities
methods.description: Loads and returns the entities configured for purging from the specified YAML configuration file.

methods.name: getPurgeStrategy
methods.description: Creates and returns a purge strategy object based on the class name, strategy, and info array.
